description: Group benefits employee census supporting a renewal. The employer name and group number are the identifying fields used to confirm which matter this census belongs to (ADR-005): they let a human verify an association, they never create one automatically.

employee_name.instruction: Full name of the enrolled employee on this row.

coverage_tier.instruction: Coverage tier for this employee, e.g. Employee Only, Employee+Spouse, Family.

employer_name.instruction: Legal name of the employer / group sponsor this census belongs to.

group_number.instruction: The group number or policy identifier printed on the census. This is the primary correlation field. Leave empty if absent; do not infer it from the employer name.

plan_effective_date.instruction: The plan or renewal effective date, in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) if determinable.

employee_count.instruction: The total number of enrolled employees represented on this census.

employees.instruction: One entry per enrolled employee row on the census.
